jobs.title: Transformation Strategy Consultant
jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

Join the team shaping Humana’s future

Humana’s Transformation Office team is a high-performing team that works closely with senior leaders to help chart the course for the company’s future. Transformation is critical to our core strategy: delivering great healthcare to seniors, providing a differentiated healthcare experience, and growing our reach and impact with members and patients. As a member of the Transformation team, you will support the complex and coordinated effort required to execute the enterprise strategy: accelerating our long-term vision by identifying opportunities, designing solutions, and implementing initiatives to fundamentally change the member, patient, provider, and associate experiences.

The Transformation team is modeled after top-tier management consultancies. Team members work on fast-paced and high-visibility projects aligned with the enterprise’s most important Transformation topics. Every day in the role is different, but activities often include developing industry analysis, building high-level financial/business models, conducting informational interviews, managing complex projects with numerous stakeholders, and synthesizing recommendations into executive-level deliverables that drive real-world results. Work assignments require a combination of strategic thinking, quantitative analysis, workstream management, cross-team collaboration, and storytelling. Team members can align with one of the enterprise’s lines of business, supporting functions, or key Transformation capabilities to become a trusted thought partner for the Transformation agenda.
Key Responsibilities:

- Leads execution of one or more workstreams with limited support from team leadership

- Solves problems flexibly: able to effortlessly jump between quantitative analysis, qualitative research, stakeholder management, slide design, etc.

- Delivers high-quality , data-backed deliverables with limited rework

- Translates insights into effective written communication, typically PowerPoint

- Develops trust-based relationships with business partners

- Demonstrates a growth mindset, requesting and acting upon coaching and feedback to accelerate professional development

- Program management experience on driving large-scale, transformational change programs

Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

Qualified candidates will possess a Bachelor’s degree with 3+ years of experience, or a Master’s degree (e.g., MBA, MHA, MPH, or equivalent) with 2+ years of experience in one of the following:
o      Management consulting , with   experience solving strategic and operational problems for large-scale businesses , OR
o      Healthcare industry experience  (payer, provider, or insurance preferred), with involvement in strategy, operations, or transformation efforts

All candidates must meet the following:
-   Demonstrable capabilities with quantitative analysis and research, stakeholder management, slide design   executive communications in PowerPoint or Word formats
- Demonstrated ability to structure problems and develop business recommendations using hypothesis-driven thinking
- Experience supporting complex or cross-functional workstreams, with exposure to stakeholder-driven environments

Preferred Qualifications

- Ability to identify , structure, and solve business problems

- Healthcare / payer experience

- Project management experience

Location: W orking locations are Louisville, KY and Arlington, VA (Washington, DC metro area.) The Transformation team operates on a hybrid work arrangement (in office expectation of 3 days per week). Relocation assistance available. Remote NY will be considered.

Travel :
Occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required .

40

jobs.title: Value Management & Financial Operations Lead
jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

At Humana, we are focused on maximizing the value of our investments and ensuring disciplined financial management across our portfolio of initiatives. In this role, you will lead financial operations, budget planning, forecasting, value management, and investment evaluation activities that support executive decision-making and strategic portfolio governance. You will partner across business, technology, finance, and operational teams to identify opportunities, quantify value, evaluate investment decisions, and monitor realization of expected outcomes.

The core work hours will be based on EASTERN time, with flexibility based on exact location.

The Delivery Lead oversees financial operations and value management activities that enable effective portfolio governance and investment decision-making. This role is responsible for operational budget management, forecasting, invoicing oversight, financial reporting, and performance tracking across a complex portfolio of initiatives.

The Delivery Lead develops business cases, identifies and quantifies expected value, supports investment evaluations, and establishes processes to monitor benefits realization. This role partners with leaders across the organization to evaluate new opportunities, assess strategic investments, and ensure alignment between financial commitments and expected business outcomes.

The selected candidate will establish portfolio-level reporting and scorecards, monitor expected versus realized value, identify risks and opportunities impacting financial performance, and provide recommendations to senior leadership to support strategic decision-making.

The Delivery Lead exercises independent judgment and decision-making on complex issues, works under minimal supervision, and requires strong analytical, financial, and stakeholder management capabilities.

Use your skills to make an impact

Key Responsibilities:
- Lead operational budget management, forecasting, invoicing, and financial planning activities.
- Develop and maintain portfolio-level financial reporting and performance scorecards.
- Partner with business and technology leaders to develop business cases and investment recommendations.
- Identify, quantify, and track expected value associated with strategic initiatives.
- Establish and maintain processes for value realization measurement and reporting.
- Support portfolio governance processes, including investment prioritization and funding reviews.
- Analyze financial and operational performance trends and make recommendations to improve outcomes.
- Communicate portfolio performance, investment recommendations, and realized value to senior leadership and key stakeholders.
- Maintain visibility into portfolio spend, forecast accuracy, and investment performance.
- Drive continuous improvement of value management and financial operations capabilities.

Required Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree or 7+ years of healthcare, finance, operations, strategy, or portfolio management experience.
- 5+ years of financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, or business operations experience.
- Experience developing business cases and evaluating investment opportunities.
- Experience analyzing and communicating financial and operational performance metrics.
- Experience leading highly complex cross-functional initiatives.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and executive communication skills.
- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and financial modeling.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience supporting large-scale healthcare, technology, or transformation portfolios.
- Experience with benefits realization, value management, or portfolio management disciplines.
- Experience preparing materials and recommendations for executive leadership review.
- Knowledge of healthcare payer operations, Stars, Risk Adjustment, Clinical Data Exchange, or Technology portfolios.
- MBA, CPA, PMP, or similar advanced certification.

Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.
Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

jobs.title: Assistant Vice President, Corporate Development Integration & Value Creation
jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

Humana is seeking an experienced and strategic Assistant Vice President (AVP), Integration & Value Creation to lead enterprise-wide transformation initiatives and complex integration programs that drive measurable business outcomes. This leader will serve as a critical bridge between strategy and execution, ensuring that acquisitions, strategic partnerships, organizational transformations, and enterprise initiatives achieve targeted value realization and sustainable operational performance.
The AVP will provide leadership across the full lifecycle of integration and value creation efforts—from strategy development and due diligence through execution, stabilization, and benefit realization. This role requires a highly influential leader who can effectively partner with senior executives, business leaders, and cross-functional teams to accelerate growth, optimize operations, and deliver lasting enterprise value.

Key Responsibilities
Integration Strategy & Execution
- Lead end-to-end integration planning and execution for mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, joint ventures, and strategic enterprise initiatives.
- Develop and implement integration frameworks, governance structures, and operating models that support business objectives.
- Establish Day 1 readiness plans, stabilization milestones, and long-term integration roadmaps.
- Identify and mitigate integration risks while ensuring continuity of business operations.

Value Creation & Transformation
- Define value creation opportunities and measurable business outcomes aligned with enterprise strategy.
- Translate strategic objectives into executable programs that deliver operational, financial, and organizational benefits.
- Develop business cases, synergy targets, and realization plans in partnership with Finance and business leaders.
- Monitor and report value realization metrics, ensuring accountability for outcomes and corrective actions where needed.

Cross-Functional Leadership
- Lead cross-functional teams across Finance, HR, Operations, Technology, Compliance, Legal, and Business Segments.
- Foster alignment among stakeholders to accelerate decision-making and remove barriers to execution.
- Drive enterprise collaboration to ensure integrated solutions and sustainable change adoption.

Executive Engagement & Governance
- Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership regarding integration, transformation, and value realization initiatives.
- Prepare and present updates, recommendations, risks, and performance outcomes to the Executive Leadership Team and other governance bodies.
- Facilitate executive steering committees and decision forums to ensure timely resolution of key issues.

Change Management & Culture Integration
- Partner with organizational effectiveness and change management teams to support workforce transitions and cultural integration.
- Develop stakeholder engagement strategies that improve adoption, minimize disruption, and strengthen employee experience.
- Promote enterprise values and leadership behaviors throughout transformation efforts.

Program Leadership & Continuous Improvement
- Establish KPI dashboards and performance metrics to track initiative progress and business impact.
- Implement best practices, lessons learned, and continuous improvement processes across integration and transformation programs.
- Build organizational capability in integration management, value realization, and strategic execution.

Required Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Healthcare Administration, Operations, or related field.
- 12+ years of progressive leadership experience in strategy execution, transformation, integration, consulting, operations, or corporate development.
- Demonstrated success leading complex enterprise-wide initiatives and large-scale transformational programs.
- Experience managing cross-functional teams in highly matrixed organizations.
- Strong financial acumen with experience developing business cases, synergy models, and value realization plans.
- Proven ability to influence senior executives and drive alignment across multiple stakeholders.
- Exceptional communication, facilitation, and executive presentation skills.

Use your skills to make an impact

Preferred Qualifications
- Master's degree (MBA, MHA, or related advanced degree).
- Healthcare payer, healthcare services, or healthcare technology industry experience.
- Experience leading M&A integrations and post-transaction value capture initiatives.
- Background in management consulting, enterprise transformation, corporate strategy, or operations leadership.
- Certification in Program Management, Change Management, Lean, Six Sigma, or related disciplines.

jobs.title: Analyst, Corporate Development and Venture Capital
jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

Are you passionate about driving strategic growth and making an impact at the highest levels? As a Analyst on Humana's Corporate Development and Venture Capital team, you will be responsible for driving deal execution from end to end. This includes managing the due diligence process, and liaising with third-party advisors, such as law firms, investment banks, consultancy, and accounting firms. Additionally, you will ensure the transaction process runs smoothly through to completion. You will identify, research, analyze, make recommendations and negotiate potential investments, mergers, acquisitions and divestitures to support the organization's growth objectives. In this role, you will work closely with other senior members of the team and Humana's senior leadership/segment leads. You will be critical in making recommendations regarding the impact of possible mergers/acquisitions and divestitures on the organization's strategy and profitability.

As you advance, you'll have opportunities to help define and promote strategic initiatives across the enterprise, working with visionary leaders to identify and pursue innovative, growth opportunities. Reporting to the VP of Corporate Development and Venture Capital, you'll be empowered to deliver high-impact results and advance your career in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
The Analyst will provide technical expertise in executing deal work that will focus on:
- Driving deal processes from end to end, including developing timelines and deal strategies
- Being responsible for a detailed understanding of the business being acquired or divested
- Modeling the financial profile of the business, including the detailed support of company projections
- Helping lead cross-functional corporate development projects executed in partnership with senior leadership and business development teams
- Converting strategy into business cases and corporate development opportunities
- Managing external relationships with key business partners
- Working with Humana and Corporate Development leadership to establish and communicate the corporate development strategy
- Developing and refining key team operating systems and managing deal members

Successful candidates will possess the following attributes:
- Ability to identify, structure and solve business problems

- Strong business acumen and analytical skills
- Passion for people development and demonstrated leadership success
- Excellent interpersonal, organizational, written, and oral communication and presentation skills

jobs.title: Summer 2027 MBA Internship – Strategy and Operations
jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

Humana invites MBA and other advanced-degree students to join its Summer 2027 Internship Program. This immersive experience allows students to contribute to meaningful, enterprise-level work across a range of business functions, engage with executive leaders, and develop the skills and perspective needed for a successful healthcare career after graduation.

We are seeking purpose-driven leaders who demonstrate intellectual curiosity, agility, sound judgment, and a high degree of emotional intelligence. Strong candidates embrace complex challenges, navigate ambiguity confidently, and are motivated to shape the future of healthcare.

MBA Strategy & Operations Internship opportunities are available across several strategic areas, including:
- CenterWell Pharmacy – Business Development

- CenterWell Pharmacy Hub Team

- CenterWell Pharmacy Operations

- Consumer Product Enablement & Solutions

- Corporate Strategy

- Insurance Product Solutions

- Pharmacy Business Integration

- Pharmacy Product Management

- Provider Network Operations – Humana Military

- Sales Strategy

- Transformation Office

- Value-Based Care Enablement Strategy

Across these strategic areas, interns help translate priorities into action through strategic planning, business case development, cross-functional coordination, process improvement, portfolio execution, and transformation support. Interns may contribute to initiatives that improve efficiency and deliver greater value while supporting enterprise goals, governance, and continuous improvement.

Location and work arrangement : This is a 12-week, in-person internship based primarily at Humana’s headquarters in Louisville, KY, with limited opportunities in Arlington, VA; Fort Lauderdale, FL; Nashville, TN; and New York, NY. Interns should expect to work in the office three to four days per week, depending on leader and team needs. Remote opportunities are not available.

Please note: Candidates who receive a full-time offer after the internship will be required to work in or relocate to one of the locations listed above.

Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications:
- Currently enrolled in a Master of Business Administration (MBA) or another advanced professional degree program, such as an MPH, MD, JD, or PhD, with an expected graduation date in spring or summer 2028

- Available to work full time, 40 hours per week, throughout the Summer 2027 program from May 24, 2027, through August 13, 2027.

- Must be willing to work in-person 3-4 days per week for the duration of the internship in either Louisville, KY; Arlington, VA; Fort Lauderdale, FL; Nashville, TN; and New York, NY.

- Must not require sponsorship to work in the United States either now or in the future

- Minimum of three years of professional experience completed before beginning graduate school

- Demonstrated leadership through professional, academic, military, or extracurricular experiences, with a record of guiding teams, advancing cross-functional initiatives, influencing stakeholders, and delivering measurable results in a dynamic environment

Preferred Qualifications:
- Healthcare and Business Acumen: Demonstrated interest in the evolving healthcare landscape, including payer, provider, pharmacy, primary care, value-based care, consumer experience, or adjacent healthcare services, with the ability to connect industry dynamics to enterprise priorities and growth opportunities.

- Strategic, Financial, and Analytical Problem-Solving: Ability to structure ambiguous problems, evaluate market, financial, operational, clinical, and consumer information, and translate insights into data-informed recommendations, business cases, and implementation priorities.

- Execution and Learning Agility:  Demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguity, create structure, prioritize effectively, adapt quickly, and advance work with accountability and ownership.

- Cross-Functional Influence:  Strong relationship-building and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively and influence stakeholders across clinical, operational, technology, finance, and business teams.

- Executive Communication:  Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate complex information clearly, concisely, and effectively to diverse audiences.

Internship Program Overview:
- Onboarding and orientation  designed to introduce Humana’s culture, mission, strategy, and enterprise priorities and help interns prepare for their assigned business area.

jobs.title: M&A Integration Technology Lead
jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

The M&A IT integration leader will provide strategic guidance with regards to IT integration efforts to Humana's corporate development team and integration management office (IMO) on all growth opportunities (M&As, Divestitures, Joint Ventures (JVs), and Minority Investments). This position is a direct report to the AVP, IT M&A, and will work closely with senior executives, corporate development team, IMO, acquired company representatives, and internal cross-functional IT teams in evaluating potential target companies and in the development and implementation of IT integration plans.

This role will be remote but the hired candidate must reside within commutable distance of one of our office locations in the following areas: Louisville, KY or Arlington, VA.

The ideal and successful candidate will have direct M&A integration experience. This is not a project or program management role.

Key Responsibilities :
IT Due Diligence
- Lead IT due diligence activities across mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, joint ventures, and strategic investments, assessing technology platforms, infrastructure, applications, data, cybersecurity, operating models, and IT organization capabilities.
- Identify integration risks, operational dependencies, technology constraints, and value-creation opportunities that may impact deal structure, execution, or synergy realization.
- Develop IT integration cost estimates and investment models spanning infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, applications, data, and end-user technologies.
- Evaluate target-state integration approaches and define high-level IT integration hypotheses aligned to the transaction strategy.
- Partner with Corporate Development, Legal, the Integration Management Office (IMO), and target company leadership to inform transition services agreements (TSAs) and separation planning activities.
- Provide concise executive-level updates, recommendations, and risk assessments to senior business and IT leaders throughout the diligence process.
- Establish trusted relationships with executive stakeholders, effectively influencing decisions and aligning diverse interests across internal and external parties.

IT Integration Planning & Execution
- Conduct comprehensive assessments of people, processes, technology, data, cybersecurity, and vendor landscapes to identify integration gaps, risks, and opportunities.
- Develop and manage end-to-end IT integration plans, including Day 1 readiness, Day 1+ execution, milestones, dependencies, resource requirements, and synergy initiatives.
- Ensure IT integration strategies align with transaction objectives, business priorities, value drivers, compliance requirements, and expected synergies.
- Lead day-to-day integration execution across cross-functional IT teams, driving accountability, issue resolution, decision-making, and milestone achievement.
- Manage the transition and integration of technology assets, contracts, vendors, applications, infrastructure, and IT personnel as required by the transaction.
- Proactively identify, mitigate, and escalate risks while partnering with business leaders, IMO, and technical teams to resolve complex operational and technical challenges.
- Develop and execute comprehensive stakeholder engagement and communication strategies, ensuring transparency, alignment, and change adoption across executive leadership, business teams, and acquired organizations.
- Partner with IT Finance to develop, manage, and track integration budgets, synergy targets, and investment commitments.

IT Integration Governance & Process Excellence
- Continuously enhance IT M&A methodologies, governance frameworks, tools, playbooks, and best practices based on lessons learned and evolving business needs.
- Serve as a change leader by articulating transaction objectives, integration strategy, and value realization goals to stakeholders across Humana and acquired organizations.
- Lead IT integration governance forums and steering committees, facilitating executive decision-making regarding priorities, risks, resources, and strategic outcomes.
- Drive effective executive communications through status reporting, risk management reviews, steering committee materials, and leadership presentations.

Integration Results & Value Realization
- Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and success metrics that measure integration progress, synergy realization, operational stability, and business value delivery.
- Analyze integration performance against planned objectives and recommend corrective actions where necessary.
- Document lessons learned and institutionalize best practices to improve future M&A integration efforts.
- Prepare and deliver executive-level presentations and strategic updates on integration progress, outcomes, risks, and value realization.

Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Engineering, or related field.
- 8+ years of progressive technology leadership experience, including experience in one or more of the following areas: - Enterprise applications and systems integration, architecture or technology transformation initiatives
- Infrastructure, networking, and end-user computing
- Cloud platforms and migration programs (Azure, AWS, or GCP)
- Cybersecurity, identity and access management, and risk management
- Data management, analytics, and information governance
- IT program/project delivery in large, complex organizations

- 8+ years of experience supporting mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, business transformations, or large-scale enterprise integration initiatives.
- 8+ years of project, program, or cross-functional team leadership experience developing technology roadmaps, integration strategies, business cases, and executive-level presentations.
- Demonstrated ability to influence and communicate effectively with executive leadership, technical teams, external partners, and acquired company representatives.
- Strong understanding of IT governance, technology risk management, cybersecurity principles, and enterprise architecture concepts.

Preferred Qualifications:
The following qualifications would distinguish an exceptional candidate:
Direct IT M&A Leadership Experience
- 10+ years leading IT due diligence, integration, or separation activities across mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, or joint ventures, preferably within a highly regulated industry such as healthcare, financial services, or insurance.
- Experience with Microsoft Azure, AWS, or hybrid cloud environments.
- Experience integrating enterprise platforms such as Microsoft 365, Active Directory/Azure AD (Entra ID), Salesforce, ServiceNow, ERP systems, or healthcare technology platforms.
- Familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks, identity management, data migration, and application rationalization activities.
- Experience using portfolio, project, and integration management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Smartsheet, Clarity, or ServiceNow.

Relevant Professional Certifications
- One or more of the following: - Project Management Professional (PMP)
- TOGAF Certified
- Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
- Azure Solutions Architect Expert, AWS Solutions Architect, or equivalent cloud certification.

Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.
Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

jobs.title: Regional VP, Operations & Finance (Regional CFO)
jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Regional VP, Operations & Finance is accountable for the regional P&L. This seasoned Health Plan leader collects, analyzes and reports on various market data to connect financial outcomes with operational effectiveness. The Regional VP, Operations & Finance requires an in-depth understanding of health plan financials and how health plan operations impact financial performance.

The Regional VP, Operations and Finance in the South Central (TX, OK and AR) region is a Chief Financial Officer position with Operations elements as well. The Regional VP, Operations and Finance requires an in-depth understanding of how organization capabilities interrelate across segments and/or enterprise-wide to develop strategies to improve outcomes that support the region’s membership, medical expense, admin and margin targets.

To be successful, the Regional Vice President, Operations and Finance will provide leadership and direction to the regional Finance team. In addition, this leader will serve as a member of the Regional Leadership team, collaborating with Provider Network, Health Services and Network Performance peers to lead product, network, quality and operational strategy and execution.  This individual will lead the annual Medicare Advantage product bid process, working closely with enterprise product, finance and growth teams. As the Regional CFO, this leader will develop and provide fiscal and operational oversight of the regional annual budget, financial planning and projections, risk management and operational metrics and reporting. As a member of the regional leadership team, the RVP Operations & Finance must be comfortable with strategic discussions with physician and hospital leaders, and leading finance associates who identify financial drivers to performance of value-based providers.  The role interfaces regularly with regional, divisional and corporate leaders.

The RVP reports to the Regional President with 4 direct reports. Total team size of 9.

- Lead regional market level strategy development process with operational leaders.
- Direct accountability for regional P&L and achieving margin and administrative budget targets.
- Direct the design and implementation of policies and procedures which result in increased performance, are properly integrated with other units, and comply with federal and state regulatory requirements
- Establish and maintain management and performance controls by identifying, tracking, measuring and analyzing data to highlight problems, prevent losses, contain costs and direct the development of process improvements
- Leads the annual CMS bid process
- Maintains administrative budget oversight for regional functions and provides strategic and financial analysis to support provider contracting and performance, health services and trend identification
- Cultivate internal and external business relationships which will serve as resources for technical knowledge and performance improvement

Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

- Knowledge of Medicare, Medicare Advantage and Part D coverage, and participation and/or intimate knowledge of the annual CMS bid process
- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Accounting or a related field
- 8 plus years  of finance experience in the health solutions industry ( preferably with 3 plus years as a CFO role or COO with finance experience)
- Demonstrated leadership skills. Experience building a high performing team to support a growth market
- Knowledge of CMS bid mechanics and bid tools
- Excellent communication and presentation skills
- Ability to collaborate in a positive manner with all levels of the organization
- Management and leadership experience
- Willingness to travel a minimum of 20% within the region
- Must reside in or be willing to relocate to Texas, Arkansas or Oklahoma (preferably TX)

Preferred Qualifications
- Certified Public Accountant
- Master's Degree in Business, Finance, Accounting or a related field
- Knowledge of the South Central Region market dynamics and Value Based Care
- Experience working with physician groups, provider contracting, market operations, and Medicare Risk Adjustment and Stars/Quality functions

Additional Information
- Ability to relocate or reside in Texas, Oklahoma or Arkansas (preferably TX)
